Important Fraud Information

  • We will never send SMS with a link to click
  • We will never ask for a security code over the phone
  • We will never ask you to authenticate a refund

If you ever get an email, text message, or pop-up asking for any of these please contact us on: 0818 50 24 24 or +353 1 212 4101
